scientific_integrity: The original paper's ordinary/fine spectral conclusions and classical unilateral-shift index theory are credited as prior inputs. Finite arithmetic tests support specific identities only; the complete theorem rests on an analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Only positive real power weights and symbols in the displayed weighted analytic Wiener class; does not determine all bounded convolution symbols, non-power Hahn weights, or other essential-spectrum conventions. Approximation-number rate is for a canonical representation-dependent compact defect. Standard Wiener factorization is not novel, and publication priority is not independently established.
title: Power-weighted Hahn convolution: an exact Calkin norm and a sharp compact-defect law
